title: Battle of Landeshut (1760)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Landeshut (1760)", at revision 1382471718, opens: "The Battle of Landeshut was an engagement fought on 23 June 1760 during the Third Silesian War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q697913, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1760 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
